description: Groups multiple ISpreadsheetCommand instances into a single undoable unit. Execute() runs them in insertion order; Undo() reverses them. Hand the batch to SpreadsheetCommandManager.Execute so one Ctrl+Z reverts the whole group.

members.name: Add
members.description: Appends a command to the batch.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Runs every command in insertion order.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Undoes every command in reverse order.

examples.title: Use BatchCommand
